PartNumber.description:
This allows for many declarations covering the goods identified by the same UCR (see DECLN-UCR). The part number is up to 3 digits (N..3). The element may also contain a check letter (A1) covering the DECLN-UCR and any part number. 
For Exports, where the goods are declared in parts, each part is explicitly identified by the DECLN-PART-NO when it is arrived or consolidated. See also MOVT-REF for identifying split movements.
There is no correspondence between the parts used in PSAs and those that may be used for the supplementary declarations. Thus, for example, supplementary declaration part 2 can cover parts 1 to 17 which departed from the same location on the same day.

EntryNumber.description:
The Entry number is a reference that is unique within an EPU and the date of Entry. It is allocated by CHIEF for DTI entries.
The format is:
For Imports: NNNNNNC
For Exports: ANNNNNC
where:
C = check letter.

RelatedPartyIndicator.description:
A check-box indication that, during the fiscal year, either the USPPI or foreign ultimate consignee reported owned 10% or more of the other’s voting securities. 
Y = Yes; Companies related. 
N = No; Companies NOT related.

An indication of whether the shipment is being ‘transported under bond’.
36 = Warehouse withdrawal for IE
37 = Warehouse withdrawal for T&E 
67 = Foreign Trade Zone withdrawal for IE

ForeignTradeZoneIdentifier.description:

RoutedIndicator.description:
A check-box indication that the foreign principal party in interest has authorized a U.S. forwarding or other agent to facilitate the export of the merchandise from the U.S.
Y = Yes; shipment is a routed transaction.
N = No; shipment is NOT a routed transaction

SoldenRoute.description:
Sold en route indicator,
N= Consignee is known at time of export and the consignee name and address will be required for transmit in AES. 
Y= Consignee is unknown at time of export and the shipment must be reported again within 4 days to notify customs of consignee name and address.
